read: Products: distributed control systems, safety instrumented systems, migration services
Industries served: refining, petrochemicals, LNG, gas processing, water
Case studies: 6, all brownfield migrations at sites with 1,000+ staff
interview: Who signs off a migration? Usually the plant director with the head of automation.
What triggers a project? A turnaround, a new plant head, or end-of-support on the old system.
